title: Unsynchronized read of the bleve index cache
description: TotalDocs() ranges over b.cache without taking cacheMu.RLock(), while BuildIndex writes under lock. Concurrent map read and write can cause fatal error, killing process. Also reachable from BleveIndexMetrics.Collect on every /metrics scrape. Fix: guard the reader with RLock/RUnlock.

title: Postgres skip papers over a startup-latency regression this PR introduces
description: NewResourceServer runs s.Init(ctx) synchronously, executing DB work before module reports running. Test has fixed 500ms sleep before checking /metrics, but on postgres in Drone this exceeds 500ms. Skip was disabled rather than fixed. Fix: replace fixed sleep with poll using require.Eventually.
